our_interpretation: The claim concerns the January 3, 2026 exchange described in the post.
Fabrication means a false denial and unsupported explanation, without implying deliberate deception.
On its own means the language model without a browser, retrieval service, or other external tool. It does not mean the complete ChatGPT product lacked search capabilities.
Reporting by any reputable news organization satisfies the wording; reports from all three named outlets are not required.
criteria.support_condition: The recorded response falsely denied the capture after reputable reporting existed, and consulting live websites requires an external capability beyond the unaided language model.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The recorded denial was accurate when made, reputable reporting did not yet exist, or the unaided model could itself retrieve live website content without an external tool or service.
